top_categories.workout_context: 67 miles on fast tropical plains with a decisive mountain burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
Race-pace efforts that mimic GFNY Villavicencio's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before April.
When someone attacks on fast tropical plains with a decisive mountain, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
GFNY Villavicencio's fast tropical plains with a decisive mountain forces constant power changes. Accelerate over rises and out of corners, settle on the open road, and repeat for 67 miles.
63ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
At GFNY Villavicencio, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
Base fitness for GFNY Villavicencio. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of GFNY Villavicencio. Train it until it feels boring.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At GFNY Villavicencio, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
Short, max efforts are unavoidable. Punchy climbs, gap closures, attacks on fast tropical plains with a decisive mountain. If you haven't trained them, you'll crack.
Varied gradients on fast tropical plains with a decisive mountain demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
The aerobic base that lets you ride fast tropical plains with a decisive mountain at tempo for 67 miles without cracking. No shortcuts.

race_overlay.heat: April in Villavicencio, Meta, Colombia can bring heat. Complete 3–4 heat exposure sessions in the final 2 weeks before GFNY Villavicencio. Increase sodium intake 48 hours before race day.
race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for GFNY Villavicencio’s 67 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum, more in heat.
race_overlay.altitude: Moderate altitude at GFNY Villavicencio. Arrive 2–3 days early. Reduce intensity expectations by 5–10%. Hydrate aggressively.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at GFNY Villavicencio requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on fast tropical plains with a decisive mountain climb to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, Race Simulation, and VO2max to prepare you for 67 miles of fast tropical plains with a decisive mountain climb in Villavicencio, Meta, Colombia.
